Test a selective weighted combination over the full pool using softmax‑negative‑error weights to see if a more aggressive weighting improves over the inverse‑error weighted pool4.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a robust median over the full pool may handle outliers and correlated errors.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a selective weighted combination on the full pool may capture the best performers while reducing variance.
Use a selective mean over the top‑8 models (pool4) to test a very simple combination that may benefit from the strong trend dominance and moderate ranking stability.
The series has moderate ranking stability and strong trend; a per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture the few models that lead at each step, so try weighted pool_full with topk_mean_per_horizon.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a robust median over a selective pool may reduce influence of correlated errors while still focusing on strong models.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a robust trimmed‑mean over the full pool may reduce influence of the few high‑error outliers while keeping most models.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; testing a per-horizon selective combination on the high‑performing pool4 may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a robust trimmed mean over the selective pool may reduce the impact of correlated errors while keeping the strong models.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.5032. Series context: trend strength 0.9853 and seasonal strength 0.2649; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.563); 9 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 21.689.
